description: McNemar's test comparing Random Forest (deployed v2 model) against XGBoost (closest competitor by F1/ROC-AUC) on the same 220-row held-out test set. Addresses Chapter 2's critique (Frontiers 2026 source) of model comparisons in this literature that omit significance testing.

models_compared.model_b: XGBClassifier, refit with hyperparameters and random_state from 20260815T135337Z_corrected_noleak_xgboost.json (no XGBoost artifact was persisted at training time; refit here only to obtain per-row test-set predictions -- not a change to the deployed model)
